name: Exterior Trim Caulking
intent: Caulk trim joints and casing perimeters after prime cures. Trim joints 90 LF/hr, casing joints 80 LF/hr.
doctrine: Post-prime caulking. Caulk adheres to primed surface, finish coats seal over for weather protection. Trim joints at 90 LF/hr, casing perimeter at 80 LF/hr.
